Title: Prohibits the giveaway or exchange of live fish as prizes in games, drawing, contests, sweepstakes or promotions
Summary: Prohibits the giveaway or exchange of live fish as prizes in games, drawings, contests, sweepstakes or promotions.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the agriculture and markets law, in relation to prohibiting the giveaway or exchange of live fish as prizes in games, drawing, contests, sweepstakes or promotions
